items.title: Dick Spottswood interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, February 13, 2023
items.q: It kind of left Oklahoma City with Charlie Christian.

ctx.x: Yeah Jay McShann and all those fellas talked about, you know their territory, and that their gigs were dances. And it sort of begs the question that comes about jazz and dance and jazz as a form of entertainment, and what happened when it stopped being so entertaining. I’m not sure we need to go there.
Well it left the south and went to the north. Bop didn’t really get to San Antonio and Oklahoma City, did it? It kind of left Oklahoma City with Charlie Christian.
